name: Necromancer: Harrowing Winds splashes once around the Glacial Impact target (#7197)
contract: Harrowing Winds 705745 turns Glacial Impact damage 707592 into one Harrowing Winds 707575 cast at the primary target: TARGET_DEST_TARGET_ENEMY with TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY in a 6 yard radius (SpellRadius 29), up to 8 enemies, line of sight from the primary target. Each enemy in the radius, the primary target included, takes it once, and an enemy 9 yards away takes none. Live combat logs from 2026-08 show the primary target among the hits in 2514 of 2583 splashes, never one enemy twice and at most 8 enemies.
